excluded_attested.gold_pickup: Gold-as-item (BH: coins occupy backpack space) -- our game has no shop/gold economy loop; excluded as a non-portable resource verb.
excluded_attested.mana_conductivity: Mana Stone conductive-path powering (BH sec4 P6) -- superseded by our own Linker connectivity mechanic; not re-added as a generic verb to avoid a duplicate system.
excluded_attested.energy_cost: Energy/turn spend to use an item (BH sec5) -- we have no turn-based energy resource; combat is tick-driven, not energy-gated.
excluded_attested.stamina_cost: Stamina cost/regen per attack (BB sec5) -- real-time stamina-gating resource, not part of our tick/BP model.
excluded_attested.shop_reroll: Shop reroll / reserve / sell-for-half (BB/Brawl sec8) -- meta-loop economy verbs, not combat effect verbs; out of scope for the effect vocab.
excluded_attested.recipe_craft: Adjacency-combine crafting into a new item (BB/Brawl sec4 P10, sec7) -- a content/authoring-time transform, not a runtime combat verb; would require a separate crafting-rule system.
excluded_attested.refinery_mod: Paid stat-mod purchase (BH Refinery, sec7) -- gold-gated meta upgrade, not a runtime effect.
excluded_attested.accuracy_crit: Accuracy%/miss and crit-double-damage (BB sec5) -- adds a hit/miss RNG layer our combat model doesn't have; deferred, not part of this vocab.
excluded_attested.charm_status: Charm status (flips enemy to your side, BH sec6) -- PvE-encounter-flipping status with no defined ally-side semantics in our engine; excluded pending a combat-side redesign.
